# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** 8 years old  <sub>[v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is a fair-haired girl with long, sleek, perfectly neat curls and a straight nose. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes and a mouth often set in a quiet, proper expression. She typically presents a very tidy, starched appearance.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025)_

## Personality

Lucy is remarkably quiet, well-behaved, and submissive. She is dependable, highly neat, and methodical in her chores and schoolwork, though somewhat lacking in imagination. She possesses an unvarying, calm temperament that is rarely unsettled.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P32](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0032), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P88](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0088), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)_

- Systematic gardening and chores  <sub>[v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

## History

Following the death of their sickly mother, Lucy and her twin brother Robin were brought to Grey Shutters by Thirza to be raised. She settled quickly into the household, proving to be quiet, orderly, and helpful with small chores. Though frequently subjected to Robin's mischievous pranks—such as being drenched under a pump, locked in a toolhouse, or coaxed away from Sunday School—she remained extremely well-behaved. Upon turning seven, she began attending school alongside Robin under Nell's instruction, where she enjoyed her studies and maintained neat, tidy habits.

_Sources: [v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c7 P31](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0031), [v2 c8 P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 c8 P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 c10 P36](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0036), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c22 P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037)_

## Background by volume

- Born six minutes before or after her twin brother Robin  <sub>[v2 c1 P31](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0031)</sub>
- Daughter of Mary, who was sickly for a long time before passing away  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008)</sub>
- Father died shortly after her birth  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033)</sub>
